title: Biodiversity
hook: Have you ever wondered what biodiversity means and why it matters?
explanation: Biodiversity refers to the enormous variety of living organisms on Earth. Different organisms perform different roles in ecosystems. Algae contribute oxygen, fungi and bacteria decompose organic matter, birds, bees and bats help pollinate plants, and plants capture sunlight to prepare food. Humans depend on biodiversity for food, medicines, shelter and livelihoods.
key_points: Biodiversity refers to the enormous variety of living organisms on Earth
Different organisms perform different roles in ecosystems
Algae contribute oxygen, fungi and bacteria decompose organic matter, birds, bees and bats help pollinate plants, and plants capture sunlight to prepare food
Humans depend on biodiversity for food, medicines, shelter and livelihoods
recap: In short, biodiversity is an important concept that students should understand from the key ideas above.
